# Y-A-S

> Y-A-S ApS (Yet Another Solution, CVR 45856186) is a software studio at Bådebrogade 1, 6700 Esbjerg, Denmark. It builds custom web applications in C# and Blazor, and organises hackathons and community events. It maintains the open-source Community.Blazor.MapLibre library (over 23,000 NuGet downloads as of November 2026) and organised Hack Esbjerg 2026 (19–20 March 2026: 100+ participants, 13 projects, 6 prize categories). Contact: contact@y-a-s.net.

The site is in English, with a Slovak version under /sk/.

## Projects

- [Community.Blazor.MapLibre](https://y-a-s.net/projects/community_blazor_maplibre/): open-source C# wrapper around MapLibre GL JS for interactive maps in Blazor; install with `dotnet add package Community.Blazor.MapLibre`
- [Hack Esbjerg](https://y-a-s.net/projects/hack_esbjerg/): 24-hour hackathon in Esbjerg, Denmark, organised by Y-A-S ApS on 19–20 March 2026
- [CycleBridge](https://y-a-s.net/projects/cyclebridge/): companion platform for cyclists, with a web app live today
- [Hack The Flag](https://y-a-s.net/projects/hack_the_flag/): online cryptography competition
- [Cod3rs Community](https://y-a-s.net/projects/cod3rs/): developer community in Denmark and Slovakia
- [All projects](https://y-a-s.net/projects/)
